visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outside the Shibuya PARCO building during daylight. A man with shoulder-length dark hair and a brown jacket points toward the modern architecture. Crowds of pedestrians in casual winter clothing walk through the wide, paved plaza under bright, natural sunlight. (2) Inside a vibrant commercial space, the man now wears a dark green sweater with a square pattern. The walls are adorned with purple neon lights and large-scale graphic posters featuring characters from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. The lighting is bright and stylized with neon accents. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a golden arrow object on a white display stand. The man's hand reaches out to touch the arrow. He then stands in front of a character mural, posing with one hand near his face in a dramatic gesture. (4) The camera pans across various merchandise displays, including a stone mask sculpture and acrylic character standees. A frame containing several colorful, circular character badges is shown in a close-up. Other shoppers are visible in the background browsing the well-lit store. (5) Close-up shots of the floor show stars similar to the Hollywood Walk of Fame, dedicated to anime characters like Jonathan Joestar. The man holds up a large tote bag with character art and displays several small character figures in their original retail packaging. (6) Inside the Iggy Cafe, the man holds a green and pink patterned necktie against his chest while sticking out his tongue. Close-up shots show themed food items like dog-shaped donuts and bento boxes. The lighting is warm and inviting within the indoor setting. (7) The man is shown drinking a purple-colored beverage from a branded cup and eating a round yellow snack. He stands in front of a large character sketch on the wall. The camera uses medium shots to capture his expressions of enjoyment. (8) At the checkout counter, a staff member in a pink apron assists the man. He holds a character card featuring his own photo and opens a paper fortune slip that reveals a specific Japanese character. He then displays a shiny gold sticker. (9) A first-person perspective shot looking up toward a star-shaped ceiling screen. A bright projection of a blond male anime character appears. The man's face enters the frame from below, looking upward with a wide-eyed, exaggerated expression of shock and awe.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, high-frequency "whoosh" sound effect initiates the sequence, followed immediately by high-tempo, energetic J-pop background music featuring brass instruments and a driving beat. A male voice speaks with high pitch and enthusiastic tone, welcoming the audience. (2) The rhythmic J-pop BGM continues at approximately 120 BPM. Low-level ambient noise consisting of a general public murmur and distant footsteps is audible underneath the music. The music maintains a major-mode, cheerful tonality with strong percussion. (3) A distinct metallic clinking sound is heard, likely from an object interaction. The BGM vocals swell into a chorus with clear articulation. The acoustic environment shifts slightly to a more resonant, indoor room tone as the music remains the primary signal. (4) Sounds of plastic rustling and a soft percussive thud occur. The main male speaker provides short, animated vocal reactions with high pitch variability. The BGM continues its high-energy loop with synthesized textures and a prominent electric bass line. (5) A sequence of rapid hard cuts in the audio is accompanied by quick 'pop' sound effects. The background music maintains its tempo. Audible friction sounds from fabric or paper being handled are mixed into the foreground. (6) The sound of liquid being drawn through a straw followed by a crisp crunching sound of eating is clearly audible. The J-pop music continues in the background with consistent volume, showing no ducking or compression during the sound effects. (7) A female voice with a polite, professional narrative tone speaks briefly in Japanese, followed by the sound of paper being unfolded and a light tapping on a surface. The BGM maintains its upbeat energy and rhythmic drive. (8) The background music abruptly decreases in volume to allow for a dramatic, high-arousal Japanese male voice with deep pitch and intense delivery. A series of percussive impact sound effects and a synthesized 'menacing' hum occupy the spectral space.
